threads.body: This changes the non-preview path too. For a batch spanning unrelated topics, the old implementation returned the first message's partitioned topic, while this now returns `null`; because `PulsarBatchRequest` is also used by the legacy messaging name/attribute extractors, the default span changes from `<topic> receive` to `unknown receive` and loses `messaging.destination.name`. That contradicts the stated “Default-path impact: None.” Please keep the legacy destination unchanged and expose the common-or-null destination separately for stable batch attributes/links.

replies.body:
Addressed in c5de4274ae7a926e3516c4e0ea58b1779d6bf172.

Analysis: The first fix stored the stable common-or-null destination in the request's existing destination field, unintentionally changing legacy span naming and attributes. PulsarBatchRequest now retains the original legacy destination and stores a separate common destination; PulsarBatchMessagingAttributesGetter selects the common value only when stable messaging semantic conventions are enabled.

Upsides: Default-mode span names and destination attributes remain backward compatible, while preview mode still omits misleading multi-topic batch destinations and preserves per-message link destinations.

Downsides: PulsarBatchRequest stores one additional nullable string and traverses the received batch a second time during request creation.
